citations.title: What Integrations does BombBomb Support? – Engage
excerpts: These create a direct connection between BombBomb and your CRM or sales platform. Your reps access BombBomb from inside the platform and record and send videos from within contact records, deals, or sequences — without leaving the tool.
* How to Use Microsoft Dynamics Customer Insights
## Automated Workflow Connectors — Built by BombBomb

An Automated Workflow Connector passes BombBomb video tracking data — opens, plays, clicks — back into your CRM so it appears alongside your other contact activity. This is a separate and optional connection. Automated Workflows send videos with or without it.
**Available for:** HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics Customer Insights, Outreach, Total Expert.
* Microsoft Dynamics Customer Insights Automated Workflow Connector
## Email & Communication Integrations — Built by BombBomb
|BombBomb Outlook Add-in |Record, insert, send, and track videos directly from Outlook |Live |
|Send Video Emails via Outlook |Connects Outlook to BombBomb Engage so your video emails are sent through Outlook's mail servers |Live |
|Send Video Emails via Gmail |Connects Gmail to BombBomb Engage so your video emails are sent through Gmail's mail servers |**Coming soon!** |
**Note:** The Outlook Add-in and Send Video Emails via Outlook are two separate features that do not depend on each other.
* [How to Install and Use the BombBomb Outlook Add-in](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/36073135831309)
## Other Integrations: Not Built by BombBomb
These are third-party connections built by other platforms or via BombBomb's API. They let you insert BombBomb video links into those tools.

citations.title: New BombBomb Experience – Engage
excerpts: Your BombBomb is moving to the new BombBomb experience on **November 9** . You can try it today with the toggle in your account, and switch back any time before **November 9** . Take a few minutes to look around and see what's new.
**Dashboard and recent activity.** Start here to see what's happened since your last visit.
**Video library.** All your videos are in the left sidebar.
**Notifications.** New activity shows as unread. Click one to open the video the recipient watched.
**Record your screen in Chrome or Edge.** Start a screen recording right in your browser. There's nothing to install.
**Your video page.** Vertical videos now fill the screen. If you use transcripts, viewers can search for a word and jump to that moment.
* **Easier screen recording.** Record your screen in Chrome or Edge with nothing to install. If your connection drops, your recording is saved.
* **Faster follow-up.** New activity shows as unread, so you can see who watched and follow up sooner.
* **A better video page.** Vertical videos fit your viewer's screen. If you use transcripts, viewers can search them.
**Do I need to move myself?** No. We'll move your account to the new BombBomb experience automatically on November 9.
**Can I switch back?** Before November 9, use the toggle in your account to switch back. After November 9, the new BombBomb experience will be the one you will see when logging in.

basis.reasoning: BombBomb’s support announcement describes the new experience and states that accounts would move to it on November 9, including a redesigned dashboard, video library, notifications, and recording/viewer improvements. That major experience rollout falls within the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.
